description: This file defines reflection-based utilities for converting Go types to and from unstructured data, including caching mechanisms and JSON marshaling/unmarshaling logic, used within the Kubernetes project.

methods.name: CanOmit
methods.description: Determines if a struct field can be omitted based on 'omitempty' or 'omitzero' tags and the field's value.

methods.name: GetFrom
methods.description: Retrieves a nested struct field value based on the field's path.

methods.name: Fields
methods.description: Returns a map of JSON field names to FieldCacheEntry for struct types.

methods.name: OrderedFields
methods.description: Returns an ordered list of struct fields based on JSON field names.

methods.name: CanConvertToUnstructured
methods.description: Checks if the type can be converted to unstructured data.

methods.name: ToUnstructured
methods.description: Converts a reflect.Value to an unstructured representation, handling JSON marshaling and custom converters.

methods.name: CanConvertFromUnstructured
methods.description: Checks if the type can be created from unstructured data.

methods.name: FromUnstructured
methods.description: Converts unstructured data into a specific type using JSON marshaling and unmarshaling.

methods.name: getJsonMarshaler
methods.description: Retrieves the json.Marshaler interface if implemented.

methods.name: getJsonUnmarshaler
methods.description: Retrieves the json.Unmarshaler interface if implemented.

methods.name: getUnstructuredConverter
methods.description: Retrieves the UnstructuredConverter interface if implemented.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merges new cache entries into the existing reflection cache.
